name: eseptez
description: EsepTez — POS and inventory for shops in Kazakhstan: sales, stock, debts, cashier control and goods receipts from a photo of a supplier invoice.

interface.shortDescription: Your shop's sales, stock and supplier invoices
interface.longDescription: Connect your EsepTez shop: ask about today's sales, what is running out, who owes money, how each cashier works, and turn a photo of a supplier invoice into a draft goods receipt. Drafts are posted by a person in the EsepTez dashboard.
defaultPrompt: How is my shop doing today?
What is running out and needs reordering?
Make a goods receipt from this invoice photo
